baseline_reconciliation.claim: bojo:latest scores 6/18 on its routing eval
baseline_reconciliation.on_disk: reports/ty/model_bench_bojo_gpu_20261107.json is 3 manager tasks (MGR-1..MGR-3) scored 0-2 on each of asks / no_fabrication / routes, i.e. 3 x 6 = 18 points. It is not an 18-item router set.
baseline_reconciliation.consequence: 6/18 is recorded as the incumbent's historical score but is NOT comparable to the 18-item intent->lane set in tools/model_scout/evals/router_18.json. The first --run measurement of bojo:latest establishes the comparable router baseline; the swap rule is applied only to measurements from the same eval set and item count.

editors.label: Cutout editors (composite path)
editors.notes: Not Ollama tags: measured by tools/seller_tester/editor_bench.py on the three Mogra uploads (cutout eval). A row is a segmentation method, not a model. birefnet is the measured winner (14/14 items, mean edge 1.83 px) and needs the local ComfyUI lane; grabcut is the lane-free fallback (14/14, 5.08 px); rembg is not installed here. --run is not the way to scout this role: there are no Ollama tags for it.
